text:
**用户：**
这个网站现在打开是不是叫kalo file manager?把这个名字改成Kaf Fee Meo

**AI：**
<think>Just a simple title change.</think>
<tool_2dLL name="package_proxy">
  <param name="params">{"command": "sed -i 's/Kalo File Manager/Kaf Fee Meo/' /root/kfmv4/public/index.html && cd /root/kfmv4 && pkill -f 'node dist/server' 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; nohup node dist/server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & sleep 0.5 && git add -A && git commit -m 'rename: Kalo File Manager -> Kaf Fee Meo'"}</param>
  <param name="tool_name">linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec</param>
</tool_2dLL><tool_result_6I7N name="linux_ssh:linux_ssh_exec" status="success"><content>{"packageVersion":"0.1.0","success":true,"timeoutMs":15000,"exitCode":0,"timedOut":false,"output":"[detached HEAD e130e32] rename: Kalo File Manager -> Kaf Fee Meo\n 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)","sessionId":"","error":""}</content></tool_result_6I7N>
改好了。标题栏现在显示 **Kaf Fee Meo**。

……这个名字，优雅度大概3分吧。不过洛喜欢就好。
